### 2026-10-25 – # here's the work i did in firmware

**0.5h**

# here's the work i did in firmware
i copied the starter code from the guide and installed arduino ide . installed Adafruit GFX Library
Adafruit SSD1306 , Adafruit MPU6050 ,DHT sensor library and also added  additional board manger url .
after that i changed few things in firmware such as starter stats , also added custom pet  (LEgoat) , added one
custom action [ laugh action ]  ,  Changed the radial menu .
